method_name: Virtual brain twin for stimulation in epilepsy (VBT_INS_Stimulation / python package vep-stim)

primary_source.authors: Wang HE, Dollomaja B, Triebkorn P, Duma GM, Williamson A, Makhalova J, Lemarechal J-D, Bartolomei F, Jirsa V
primary_source.title: Virtual brain twins for stimulation in epilepsy
primary_source.preprint: medRxiv 10.1101/2024.07.25.24310396 (seen in search results; not opened)
primary_source.verified_via: Europe PMC full-text XML (PMC12457187) and pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov, fetched 2026-10-31

method_summary: Patient-specific whole-brain model. Region-level (VEP atlas, 162 regions) 2D Epileptor network inverted with Stan NUTS (16 chains from 8 MAP initialisations) against SEEG and/or scalp-EEG seizure envelopes to estimate epileptogenicity (x0 / EV) per region, i.e. the epileptogenic zone network (EZN). A high-resolution cortical-surface (~20k vertices) 'Epileptor-Stimulation' model (extra stimulation-accumulating state variable m) simulates seizures induced by SEEG stimulation or temporal-interference (TI) stimulation, with electric fields from SimNIBS. Purpose in the paper: EZN DIAGNOSIS from stimulation-induced seizures, not optimisation of therapeutic stimulation.

imaging: T1-weighted MRI (MPRAGE): cortical surface + VEP-atlas parcellation (FreeSurfer)
electrophysiology: SEEG seizure recordings (bipolar montage; spontaneous and/or stimulation-induced) with onset/offset annotation
optional simultaneous scalp-EEG (forward model via Brainstorm3 / OpenMEEG gain)
stimulation_metadata: stimulated contact pair, frequency, amplitude, pulse width, duration (repo examples: data/Patient{1,2}_SEEG_stimulation.xlsx, data/Patient{1,2}_TI_stimulation.xlsx)
for TI: electrode montage and head model for SimNIBS 4.0 field calculation
derived: per-vertex electric field (.mgh on fsaverage ico5, repo data/EMF)

supported_outputs: posterior of regional excitability x0 / epileptogenicity values (EV) per VEP region -> estimated EZN
simulated source, SEEG and scalp-EEG seizure time series for a given stimulation (SEEG or TI) on high-resolution cortex
posterior predictive seizure envelopes; notebooks for posterior plots
validation_setting: Two patients (La Timone Hospital, Marseille): P1 23-year-old female, left occipital lobe epilepsy, resection, Engel II; P2 19-year-old male, left frontal lobe epilepsy, resection, Engel I. Plus synthetic data with known ground truth (e.g. ground-truth left O2 recovered in multimodal synthetic inference). No quantitative cohort-level accuracy metrics; no prospective or outcome-linked validation of stimulation effects.
limitations: Diagnostic framing (EZN estimation). Using the twin to choose or optimise therapeutic stimulation is stated as future work, not demonstrated. The protocol's virtual_patient endpoint (simulated propagation reduction vs paired no-intervention baseline) needs new simulation code built on the fitted model.
Validation on n=2 patients + synthetic data only.

Authors: 'Model-based approaches are usually computationally expensive and parameter sensitive, which may pose challenges for real time use in clinical routine, such as the optimization of stimulation parameters.' (Discussion)
Needs DW-MRI and post-implant CT in addition to SEEG; public SEEG datasets rarely include DWI.
Toolchain is Linux-oriented (FreeSurfer, MRtrix 0.3.16, FSL 5.0.11, GNU make/parallel); Brainstorm3 needs MATLAB. On this Windows machine it would need WSL2 or Docker.
Patient raw data not public (available on request from the authors).
Licence mismatch: GitHub Apache-2.0 vs Code Ocean capsules GPL (code) + CC BY-NC(-ND) 4.0 (data) per DataCite rightsList.

local_run_requirements.minimal_region_level_path: Python 3.10/3.11 env + pip install of the repo at a pinned commit (vep-stim) + tvb-library 2.10.0 + cmdstanpy (1.3.0 needs Python >=3.9) + CmdStan with a C++ toolchain (README pins Stan 2.21.0; compatibility with newer CmdStan untested). Inputs: connectome + gain matrix + SEEG envelope per patient.
local_run_requirements.full_high_resolution_path: additionally FreeSurfer, MRtrix 0.3.16, FSL 5.0.11, GARDEL, SimNIBS 4.0, Brainstorm3/MATLAB, OpenMEEG; Linux (WSL2/Docker).
